verticals.label: Private health insurance
verticals.summary: Italy's healthcare under-utilisation pattern combines high volumetric contact with low preventive uptake. Sweden demonstrates that universal-style preventive coverage closes the gap; private operators in Italy can capture the headroom — particularly on dental and elective specialist services where willingness-to-pay sits among the high-income profiles.

targets.rationale: Highest income (€95B aggregate), highest digital reach (75% internet), 27% dentist uptake but high willingness given subjective wellbeing. Primary target for digital-first private health insurance and dental bundles.
targets.addressable_market_eur_assumption: 30% conversion × €265 average annual premium for standalone dental + vision + outpatient specialist add-on

targets.rationale: 3.8M individuals with €54.9B aggregate income, asset-rich, but only 21% dentist uptake and 1.08 specialist contacts vs Traditional Social's 2.02. Largest behavioural-gap target if a navigator-mediated distribution channel is paired with the product.
targets.addressable_market_eur_assumption: 20% conversion × €260 average annual premium for navigator-supported dental + specialist bundle

targets.rationale: Smaller (1.1M individuals) but the highest dentist uptake of the high-income profiles (48%); receptive to community-mediated distribution (associations, parishes, family). Best fit for traditional broker-channel insurance products.
targets.addressable_market_eur_assumption: 25% conversion × €260 average annual premium via community-broker channel

skip.reason: Lowest income, lowest engagement, lowest willingness-to-pay; falls within public-care perimeter.
Caregiver-mediated decisions; private health insurance penetration here is conditioned on the caregiver, not the senior — different go-to-market channel.

crm_criteria: Used internet in past 7 days (digital reach)
Did NOT visit dentist in last 12 months (acquisition signal)
Reports hopes for the future (engagement signal)

verticals.label: Wealth management
verticals.tagline: Hybrid advisor, succession planning, longevity products
verticals.summary: Italy's over-65 segment holds €2.33T in household net wealth, of which €1.20T is in the top two profiles (Connected Active + Moderate Isolated). The differentiator in this vertical is channel: Connected Active wants digital-native, Moderate Isolated needs hybrid (digital + human navigator), Traditional Social demands family-mediated traditional channels.

targets.rationale: €931.8B aggregate net wealth, highest digital reach. Best fit for digital-native robo-advisor + private banking hybrid platforms, succession planning tools, longevity-linked products.
targets.addressable_market_eur_assumption: 5% AUM penetration on €30k median investable × 0.6% fee × 100% segment over 5y horizon

targets.rationale: €567.7B aggregate net wealth, 90% home-ownership, but only 34% internet. Hybrid-channel wealth management with branch + digital-light interface and navigator support is the white-space.
targets.addressable_market_eur_assumption: 4% AUM penetration on €25k median investable × 0.6% fee × hybrid-channel ramp

targets.rationale: €271.3B aggregate net wealth concentrated in property and family-decided savings. Traditional broker / family-office channel still dominant. Differentiator: succession + intergenerational planning.
targets.addressable_market_eur_assumption: Higher fee but smaller segment; family-mediated channel

skip.reason: Median net worth materially below segment average; pension-only living.
Decision capacity reduced by depressive load; risk of mis-selling. Family-only channel mandatory.

crm_criteria: Net worth proxy ≥ €200k (home ownership + financial assets)
Verbal fluency above country median (proxy for cognitive capacity)
Hope for the future = yes (engagement signal)
Internet 7d use AND/OR family member with digital access (channel routing)

verticals.label: Senior living and home services
verticals.tagline: Independent living residences, home-care subscriptions, age-in-place tech
verticals.summary: Italy's Moderate Isolated profile (3.8M individuals, asset-rich, socially under-served) is the structural opportunity for independent senior living that combines private apartments with community programmes. Connected Active is the tail target for premium products. Traditional Social is the natural target for cohousing-style models.

targets.rationale: Highest fit by far: 90% home-owners with low social network + low digital + adequate health. Selling proposition is community + navigator + maintained autonomy, not assisted living.
Smaller segment but high social-engagement preference. Fit for cohousing, age-friendly community platforms, parish-mediated services.
targets.addressable_market_eur_assumption: Cohousing entry fee + monthly community service

targets.rationale: Premium tier: digitally-managed services (smart home, on-demand companion, telehealth). Smaller share of segment but highest margin.

skip.reason: Care needs exceed senior-living model; appropriate channel is RSA (residential care) under public-private partnership.
Mental-health support requirements exceed standard senior-living staffing; specialist residential model only.

verticals.label: Pharma and OTC marketing
verticals.tagline: Chronic-care adherence, caregiver-mediated OTC, telehealth-enabled prescription
verticals.summary: Pharma's silver-economy targeting differs from financial verticals: the high-engagement Connected Active is a self-care customer, while Fragile Depressed is reached through caregivers. Moderate Isolated is the under-served opportunity if combined with a navigator channel (community pharmacy as touch-point).

targets.rationale: Highest chronic load, highest depressive load, caregiver-mediated. OTC, mental-health-adjacent, adherence packaging products. Distribution via family + community pharmacy.
targets.addressable_market_eur_assumption: €60/year per individual on adherence packaging + OTC adjacencies × 100% segment

targets.rationale: Self-managing customer, digital-native. Telehealth-enabled prescription, longevity products, premium OTC e-commerce.
targets.addressable_market_eur_assumption: €75/year on premium OTC + telehealth subscription × 100% segment

targets.rationale: Under-served by digital channels; community pharmacy is the natural touch-point. Adherence interventions can leverage the navigator-service investment.
targets.addressable_market_eur_assumption: €50/year on adherence + chronic-care OTC via pharmacy navigator × 100% segment

skip.reason: Lowest engagement, lowest digital, lowest spending capacity; appropriate channel is public health system.
Healthier than Fragile profiles, smaller segment; not differentiating commercial fit.

crm_criteria: Internet 7d use = no (community-pharmacy channel) OR yes (telehealth channel)
Cohabits with adult child / spouse (caregiver routing)
Specialist contacts ≥ 2 in 12 months (engaged with system)
